correctness.rationale: Expanding the exact Gaussian intensity I=2 exp(−s|ξ|²)(cosh(q|ξ|²)+cos(h·ξ)) gives quadratic Q=4sId+hhᵀ and quartic P4=(2s²+q²)|ξ|⁴+s|ξ|²(h·ξ)²+(h·ξ)⁴/12. For d≥2 the rank-one displacement part has a kernel, making 4s the smallest Q eigenvalue even when h=0. T=Q−4sId must be PSD rank≤1 and equals hhᵀ; its kernel recovers q²=z from P4(e)−2s². Conversely selecting h with hhᵀ=T, q=√z, and a,b=s±q>0 constructs every feasible pair. Swapping q sign and h sign corresponds to component interchange/reflection. The fourth-order necessity holds by varying q with fixed s,h while lower even jets are unchanged. The exact d=1 examples (2,1/4,1) and (41/20,47/200,4/5) both give Q=9 and P4=31/3 but distinct widths and center displacement, verified with rational arithmetic. Inspected the complete packaged rational checker and independently checked the symbolic expansions; neither finite check replaces the all-parameter algebra.
residual_risks: No quantitative noise stability follows from exact jet identifiability, and the d=1 witness establishes non-universal identification only.
